## Q1 — Which concrete code runs the memo INSERT on a default install

**Answer: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`** (the statement is built at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:40`: `"INSERT INTO \`memo\` (" + ... + ") RETURNING \`id\`, \`created_ts\`, \`updated_ts\`, \`row_status\`"`, executed via `d.db.QueryRowContext` at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41`).

How the default is determined:

1. Default flag/config value — two places, both `"sqlite"`:
   - `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:122` — `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`
   - `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:130` — `rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("driver", "sqlite", "database driver")` (bound to viper at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:151`; env override `MEMOS_DRIVER` via prefix/AutomaticEnv at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:167-169`)
   - Read into the profile at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:43` (`Driver: viper.GetString("driver")`); field declared at `/bench/repo/internal/profile/profile.go:30`.
   - With no `--dsn`, the DSN defaults to `<data>/memos_prod.db` only for sqlite: `/bench/repo/internal/profile/profile.go:110-117`.

2. Factory switch — `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:14` `NewDBDriver`, switch at `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:18`, default case taken at `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:19-20` → `sqlite.NewDB(profile)` (`/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:24`, opens `sql.Open("sqlite", ...)` with modernc driver at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`). Called from `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:57`, injected into the store at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:64` → `store.New` `/bench/repo/store/store.go:38` (field `driver Driver`, `/bench/repo/store/store.go:15`).

3. Dispatch path at save time (single interface hop, no caching/tx wrapper for memos):
   - API: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` `(*APIV1Service).CreateMemo` → `s.Store.CreateMemo` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:115`
   - `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:109` `(*Store).CreateMemo` → `s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` at `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:113`
   - Interface method declared at `/bench/repo/store/driver.go:29`; the three implementations are sqlite `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (default), postgres `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`, mysql `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`.

## Q2 — Markdown: interface exists, one concrete implementation

There is **no `gomark`** anywhere in this repo/commit (no `usememos/gomark` in `go.mod`, no `plugin/gomark` dir). Markdown is handled by an in-repo package wrapping **goldmark** (`github.com/yuin/goldmark v1.8.2`, `/bench/repo/go.mod:33`).

**An interface abstraction does exist:** `markdown.Service` at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` (methods `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`).

Concrete implementation(s) at runtime — exactly one:
